The DrillOps products

Each with its own purpose. Built around your work.

01

EOS

Reports & operations

Record each shift, review the work and understand the charges. Daily reports, approvals, production and contract rates.

02

Account

Invoices & purchase orders

A clear ledger of actual invoices and credits, with purchase orders and suppliers together in one workspace.

03

Project

Planning & people

See the program, plan the boreholes and track budget allocations. Keep training requirements close to the work.

FieldOps

Local GIS & fieldwork

Take your spatial data into the field. Work with maps, drawings and terrain, capture observations and navigate offline.

Explore FieldOps ↗

FieldMaps

Web maps & team distribution

Prepare project maps in the browser and share them with your team, so everyone can find the right places and information.
